summary_md: **Grover Kunal ([@groveriskunal](https://x.com/groveriskunal/status/2115110777270960429))** reads the fine print on **Nanbeige4.3-33B** (Apache 2.0, 512K context): it beats Qwen3.8-27B on Terminal-Bench but loses on SWE-Bench Pro and GPQA, the scores are the lab's own, and the Q4 file won't fit a 24GB GPU at full context.
relevance: A sober take on a new ~30B reasoning model, including its real memory footprint.
